name: Ferienwohnung Maria
beschreibung:
Idylllically located in Thiersee, Ferienwohnung Maria welcomes visitors with authentic Tyrolean warmth and comfortable amenities for a restful holiday.

Nearby Lake Thiersee is perfect for summer swimming, while hikes up Mount Pendling start in the village.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Maria in Thiersee offers a relaxing lakeside getaway in scenic Kufsteinerland.
